preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) and all(isinstance(cell, str) and len(cell) == 1 for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: grid is a non-empty 2D list of single-character lowercase English letters
grid has at least one row and one column

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(any(contains_cycle_at(grid, i, j) for j in range(len(grid[0]))) for i in range(len(grid)))
postconditions.description: return_value is true if and only if there exists at least one cell (i, j) in grid from which a cycle of length ≥4 can be formed by moving to adjacent cells (up, down, left, right) with the same character, without revisiting the immediately preceding cell
